t: This is St Peter's Church, at the east end of Eaton Square in Belgravia. It's a neoclassical Church of England parish church, with a portico of Ionic columns and a clock tower. In 1991 The Times wrote that it must now rank as one of the most beautiful churches in London. It's Grade II* listed. The architect was Henry Hakewill, an English architect who lived from 1771 to 1830, and the classical design you're admiring is his.
